x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
bestA = 0
bestB = 1
minDifference = 1e18
for b in range(1, n + 1):
    a1 = b * x // y
    a2 = (b * x + y - 1) // y
    diffA1 = abs(float(a1) / b - float(x) / y)
    diffA2 = abs(float(a2) / b - float(x) / y)
    if diffA1 < minDifference and abs(diffA1 - minDifference) > 1e-15:
        minDifference = diffA1
        bestA = a1
        bestB = b
    if diffA2 < minDifference and abs(diffA2 - minDifference) > 1e-15:
        minDifference = diffA2
        bestA = a2
        bestB = b
print(f"{bestA}/{bestB}")
